subject: general
question: Which of the following is the Indian railway station having the highest number of platforms?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Howrah Junction**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• **Howrah Junction** is one of the oldest and busiest railway stations in India, located in Howrah, West Bengal.
 
• It has a total of **23 platforms**, making it the station with the highest number of platforms in India.
 
• It serves as a crucial hub for both local and long-distance trains, connecting various parts of India.
 
• Howrah Junction handles a large volume of passengers daily and is equipped with various facilities to cater to travelers' needs.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **New Delhi Railway Station**

 
 
• New Delhi Railway Station is one of the major railway stations in Delhi and the second busiest in India in terms of train frequency and passenger movement.
 
• It has 16 platforms and serves as a major hub for trains connecting the northern parts of India.
 
• The station is well-equipped with modern facilities, including Wi-Fi, waiting rooms, and food courts.
 
 
 
• **Sealdah Railway Station**
 
 
• Sealdah Railway Station is one of the major railway stations in Kolkata, West Bengal.
 
• It has three main sections: Sealdah North, Sealdah Main, and Sealdah South, with a total of 20 platforms.
 
• The station handles a significant number of suburban and long-distance trains.
 
 
 
• **Chhatrapati Shivaji Maharaj Terminus (CSMT)**
 
 
• Chhatrapati Shivaji Maharaj Terminus, formerly known as Victoria Terminus, is a historic railway station in Mumbai, Maharashtra.
 
• It has 18 platforms and is one of the busiest railway stations in India.
 
• CSMT is a UNESCO World Heritage Site and serves as the headquarters of the Central Railways.
